transform: Each fit training rows only: c0=mean(C); Z=StandardScaler(B); H=(C-c0)*Z; T=StandardScaler(H). M_joint uses Z; M_interaction uses concatenated Z,T. C stays raw. Constant B produces zero Z and zero corresponding interaction.
score: R=a+b*C+Z@w+T@v; q=sigmoid(R). Save base, additive, interaction and total behavioral scores. M_joint v absent. E0 q=C. E1 w/v absent.
regularization: For n current training rows fit sklearn LogisticRegression C=1 on [raw C, U/sqrt(n*lambda)]; equivalent mean NLL + b^2/(2n)+lambda*(||w||^2+||v||^2)/2. Intercept unpenalized. One shared lambda for all behavioral coefficients; no separate interaction search.
off: Exact same fitted E1 object; no proxy large lambda.
inner: GroupKFold5 only outer training Dialogues, each inner scaler and C centering refitted. Pooled held-out Binary Brier selects penalty. Tie1e-12 prefers off then stronger regularization.

bootstrap.unit: shared Dialogue draws across seeds; mean per-seed metric differences

preliminary_signal: Relative E1: mean ECE lower; at least one proper loss lower and other not increased; improving proper loss lower in >=3/5 seeds. Report ECE-only gains separately without promoting to full success.
constraints: No CMERC training/weight edits or GPU inference
No new perturbations or change in strength/repeat count
No alternative interaction variants or post-OOF hyperparameter expansion
No independent-confirmation claim from repeatedly inspected Validation
